call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: AI Data Center Liquid Cooling Capacity & Order Visibility
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: How much of the 54% organic growth in Systems Protection is coming from direct-to-chip CDUs versus traditional air-cooled enclosures, and are you seeing any capacity constraints in your liquid cooling facilities?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Beth Wozniak (CEO) confirmed that Data Solutions grew over 100% YoY, with liquid cooling orders multiplying threefold. She highlighted that nVent added 40% manufacturing capacity in 2026 and customer order backlogs provide firm visibility through late 2027 across tier-1 hyperscalers.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Maverick Power Acquisition Synergy & Grid-to-Chip Offering
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Can you quantify the top-line contribution expected from Maverick Power in Q4, and how does combining busway and switchgear with liquid cooling differentiate nVent against Vertiv and Eaton?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Sara Zawoyski (CFO) stated Maverick adds ~19 points of growth in Q4 (~$190M-$200M annualized run-rate) and broadens nVent's portfolio into a unified 'utility-to-chip' platform. Data center builders can now procure pre-fabricated modular power skids integrated directly with nVent cooling manifolds.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Capital Allocation & Balance Sheet Firepower Post-Thermal Sale
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: With cash balances reaching $1.12B following the Thermal Management sale and robust Q3 free cash flow ($268M), what is the capital deployment hierarchy between M&A, buybacks, and debt repayment?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Sara Zawoyski noted net leverage is down below 1.2x, providing over $2.0B in balance sheet dry powder. Management prioritizes accretive electrical bolt-on acquisitions in power and grid infrastructure, complemented by opportunistic share repurchases ($100M executed YTD) and sustained dividend growth.
